    hsw.datetime::date AS date,
    AVG(hsw.visibility) AS avg_visibility,
    AVG(hsaq.pm2_5) AS avg_pm2_5
FROM 
    hourly_station_weather hsw
JOIN 
    weather_station ws ON hsw.station_id = ws.id
JOIN 
    hourly_station_air_quality hsaq ON hsw.datetime = hsaq.datetime
JOIN

WHERE

""")
